in_marathi.name: Azhagi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Azhagi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Azhagi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'azhagam', which means 'beautiful form' or 'adornment'. In Hindu mythology, Azhagi is a name for the goddess Meenakshi, who is revered for her divine beauty.
